name: gamebench
description: LLM game benchmarks on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build -w client && node scripts/desktop-check.mjs preview
scripts.check: npm run check -w client && npm run check -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && node scripts/desktop-check.mjs deploy
scripts.cf:dry-run: npm run build && node scripts/desktop-check.mjs dry-run
